name: CPU-Based Splat Sorting
aliases: WebGL-based Rendering Framework with Decoupled Sorting
definition: Sorting splats on the CPU using a WebWorker to allow the GPU to focus on rendering, avoiding the overhead of GPU sorting algorithms like bitonic sort which require many iterations.
summary: CPU-Based Splat Sorting reorders 3D Gaussian splats by depth on the central processing unit to enable correct alpha blending, distinguishing itself by offloading sorting from the GPU to improve rendering stability.
